faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Straight answers about free trials, paid packages, dashboard tasks, points, card and crypto payments, delivery times, refunds, privacy, and 24/7 support. Updated August 2026.
faq.a1: Yes. Registered members can claim free trial packages on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and 20+ other platforms. Paid packages are optional when you want instant volume.
faq.q2: Do I need to share my social media password?
faq.a2: Never. We only ask for your public username or profile link. MyFreeFollower will never request your password or login code.
faq.a3: Most orders start within seconds to a few hours. Delivery is spread out gradually so growth looks natural. Larger packages may take longer to finish.
faq.a4: We cover 24 platforms including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, Telegram, Spotify, Twitch, LinkedIn, Pinterest, and more.
faq.q5: Can I buy followers instead of using free services?
faq.a5: Yes. Browse our paid catalog for instant packages. Pay with crypto, card, PayPal, Skrill, Revolut, or bank transfer via checkout or support chat.
faq.a6: Share your referral link from the dashboard. When friends sign up and spend points, you earn a commission on their activity.
faq.q7: What can I do with my points?
faq.a7: Spend points on free trial packages — followers, likes, and views across 24 platforms. Paid packages use card or crypto checkout. Points cannot be converted to cash.
faq.a8: Reach us 24/7 via WhatsApp (+44 7544 368792), Telegram (@buycheapfollowerr), live chat, or email at support@myfreefollower.com.
faq.a9: If your follower or like count drops shortly after delivery, we top it back up during the service window — at no extra charge for eligible orders.
faq.q10: What if I enter the wrong username or link?
faq.a10: Contact support immediately with your order ID. If delivery has not started, we can usually fix the link. Once delivery begins, changes may not be possible.
faq.q11: Are the followers and likes real-looking?
faq.a11: We deliver profiles and engagement designed to look natural on your account. They build social proof at a glance — organic comments and sales still depend on your content.
faq.q12: Can I order for multiple platforms at once?
faq.a12: Yes. Many members run free trials on several networks, see which channel drives results, then scale the winner with a paid package.
faq.q13: How do points work for free services?
faq.a13: Complete tasks from your dashboard to earn points. When you have enough, redeem them for free trial packages — no card required.
faq.a14: We accept crypto through Cryptomus and Binance Pay. You receive a standard checkout flow with order tracking in your dashboard.
faq.q15: Can businesses and agencies use MyFreeFollower?
faq.a15: Yes. Brands, shops, musicians, and agencies use us for launches, social proof, and campaign boosts. We never need admin access to your accounts.
faq.q16: Do you sell or share my personal data?
faq.a16: No. We use your email and order details only to run your account and fulfill orders. See our Privacy Policy for full details.
faq.a17: Open Tasks in your dashboard, follow the task link, complete the required action, then upload a screenshot or short video as proof. An admin reviews submissions and credits points when approved.
faq.q18: Can I complete the same task twice?
faq.a18: No. Each task allows one submission per account. If an admin marks your proof as needs edit, you may resubmit only from the Proofs page with corrected media.
faq.q19: What happens if my proof is rejected?
faq.a19: A rejected proof cannot be resubmitted for that task. Read the admin note, review task instructions, and focus on other available tasks to keep earning points.
faq.q20: What is the daily login bonus?
faq.a20: Members can claim 100 bonus points once per calendar day from the Daily Bonus page. Daily bonus points are fixed and do not use the task reward multiplier.
faq.a21: Browse paid services, select a quantity tier, enter your public username or post link, and checkout with card or crypto. Paid orders do not use points.
faq.q22: Which payment methods are accepted for paid orders?
faq.a22: Card and cryptocurrency at checkout. PayPal, Skrill, Revolut, and bank transfer may be arranged via WhatsApp or live chat for custom orders.
faq.q23: Is using growth services safe for my account?
faq.a23: We never ask for passwords and deliver gradually to look natural. Third-party platforms enforce their own rules — use services responsibly and avoid spammy behavior.
faq.q24: How do I track order status?
faq.a24: Free and paid orders appear under Dashboard → Orders. Status updates from pending to processing to completed as fulfillment progresses.
faq.a25: Contact support immediately with your order ID. If delivery has not started, cancellation may be possible. After processing begins, our Refund Policy applies.
faq.q26: Do you provide invoices for businesses?
faq.a26: Email support@myfreefollower.com with your company name, tax details if applicable, and order ID. We provide payment confirmation documents where supported.
faq.a27: The website is available in 19 languages including English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Arabic, and more. Switch language from the header menu.
faq.a28: Live chat and WhatsApp are monitored 24/7. Most inquiries receive a first reply within minutes; complex order issues are typically resolved within 24 hours.
faq.q29: Do you deliver to private or restricted accounts?
faq.a29: Most services need a public profile or post URL. Private, age-restricted, or geo-blocked targets may fail delivery. Set the account or post public before ordering when possible.
faq.q30: What proof formats are accepted for tasks?
faq.a30: Upload a clear screenshot or a video up to 3 seconds showing the completed action. Cropped, blurry, unrelated, or heavily edited proofs may be rejected during review.
faq.q31: How does the referral commission work?
faq.a31: Share your referral link from the dashboard. When invited members earn and spend points on free services, you receive a commission at the rate shown in your Referrals section.
faq.q32: Can I use MyFreeFollower on mobile?
faq.a32: Yes. The site is fully responsive. Complete tasks, upload proofs, claim daily bonus, and checkout paid packages from any modern mobile browser without installing an app.

about.title: About MyFreeFollower
about.subtitle: MyFreeFollower helps creators, brands, and everyday users grow on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and 22 more networks — with free task-based trials, secure paid checkout, and round-the-clock support since 2024.
about.missionBody: MyFreeFollower makes social media growth accessible to everyone. We offer free trial packages and affordable paid boosts — so creators, small businesses, and everyday users can build real momentum without risky shortcuts.
about.howBody: Browse 90+ free follower, like, and view trials across 24 platforms with a free account. Prefer instant results? Buy followers, likes, and views at competitive prices with secure checkout.
about.trustBody: We never ask for passwords. Support is available around the clock. Orders are tracked in your dashboard, and our catalog covers every major social network you use.
about.storyBody: MyFreeFollower began with a simple belief: social growth should not require expensive ads or risky bots. We built a task economy so anyone can earn free trial packages, plus card and crypto checkout for creators who need instant volume. Today more than 120,000 members use 90+ free trials and hundreds of paid tiers across 24 platforms.
about.valuesBody: Transparency, password-free delivery, fair proof review, and honest pricing. We explain how services work, show delivery windows upfront, and staff real support agents — not anonymous ticket queues.
about.platformsBody: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, Telegram, Spotify, Twitch, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Snapchat, Discord, Reddit, and more — all from one member account. Earn task points for free trials or checkout paid packages per network.
about.supportBody: Order questions, proof issues, or payment help — reach us on WhatsApp (+44 7544 368792), Telegram (@buycheapfollowerr), live chat, or support@myfreefollower.com. We assist in multiple languages.
about.safetyBody: Orders are delivered gradually to protect account health. Abuse of free trials, fraudulent proofs, or multi-account farming results in suspension. Read our Terms and FAQ — responsible use keeps the platform fair for everyone.
about.ctaBody: Create a free account and claim your first package today.

legal.privacyIntro: This Privacy Policy explains how MyFreeFollower ("we", "us") collects, uses, stores, and protects personal information when you visit myfreefollower.com, create an account, complete tasks, or purchase growth services. By using our website you acknowledge this policy. For questions contact support@myfreefollower.com.
legal.privacySection1Body: We collect information you provide when registering (username, email, password), order details (usernames and profile links), proof submissions, and support messages. We also collect basic usage data such as IP address and browser type for security and analytics.
legal.privacySection2Body: We use your data to operate your account, process orders, review task proofs, prevent fraud, improve our services, and respond to support requests. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
legal.privacySection3Body: We use cookies to remember your language preference and session. Analytics tools help us understand how visitors use the site so we can improve the experience.
legal.privacySection4Body: We retain account data while your account is active and as required by law. We implement reasonable security measures, but no online service can guarantee absolute security.
legal.privacySection5Body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data by contacting support@myfreefollower.com. You can delete your account data by contacting us.
legal.privacySection6Body: For privacy questions, email support@myfreefollower.com or use our contact page.
legal.privacySection7Body: We use trusted infrastructure providers for hosting, payment processing, analytics, and email delivery. These partners process data only to perform services on our behalf and must protect it under contractual obligations. We do not authorize partners to sell your personal data.
legal.privacySection8Body: MyFreeFollower operates globally. Your information may be processed in countries other than your own. Where required, we apply appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses or equivalent legal mechanisms to protect cross-border transfers.
legal.privacySection9Body: Our services are not directed to children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. If you believe a child has registered, contact support@myfreefollower.com and we will delete the account promptly.
legal.privacySection10Body: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect legal, technical, or business changes. The last updated date appears at the top of this page. Material changes may be announced by email or site notice. Continued use after updates means you accept the revised policy.
legal.termsIntro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern access to MyFreeFollower.com, member accounts, free task rewards, and paid social media growth orders. Please read them carefully before registering or checking out. If you disagree with any section, do not use our services.
legal.termsSection1Body: By creating an account or placing an order, you agree to comply with these terms and all applicable laws. If you do not agree, do not use our services.
legal.termsSection2Body: You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for all activity under your account. You must provide accurate information and not create multiple accounts to abuse free trials.
legal.termsSection3Body: We provide social media growth services delivered gradually. Delivery times are estimates, not guarantees. We reserve the right to cancel or refund orders that violate platform policies or our fair-use rules.
legal.termsSection4Body: Points are earned by completing approved dashboard tasks and spent on free trial packages in the catalog. Paid services require card or crypto checkout — points cannot be used for paid orders or converted to cash. We may reject incomplete or fraudulent proofs. Referral commissions follow program rules published in your dashboard.
legal.termsSection5Body: You may not use our services for illegal activity, harassment, spam, or to violate third-party platform terms. We may suspend or terminate accounts that abuse the system.
legal.termsSection6Body: MyFreeFollower is provided as-is. We are not affiliated with Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, or any social platform. We are not liable for account actions taken by third-party platforms.
legal.termsSection7Body: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance. Contact support@myfreefollower.com with questions.
legal.termsSection8Body: Paid orders are billed at checkout in the currency shown. You authorize us and our payment partners to charge the selected method. Prices include applicable service fees displayed before confirmation. Failed crypto or card payments do not create active orders.
legal.termsSection9Body: MyFreeFollower logos, site design, and original content are protected. You may not copy, scrape, or resell our catalog without written permission. Your username and submitted proof media remain yours; you grant us a license to review proofs for task verification.
legal.termsSection10Body: Contact support first for any order dispute. We aim to resolve issues within 48 hours. Chargebacks opened without contacting support may result in account suspension while the case is reviewed.
legal.termsSection11Body: These terms are governed by applicable international commerce principles and the jurisdiction stated in our company registration, without regard to conflict-of-law rules. Local consumer rights that cannot be waived still apply where mandated by law.
legal.termsSection12Body: If any provision of these terms is found unenforceable, the remaining provisions stay in effect. Failure to enforce a right does not waive that right for the future.
legal.refundDescription: How we handle refunds when an order cannot be completed as described.
legal.refundIntro: This Refund Policy describes when refunds or order credits apply, how to open a case, and expected timelines. We aim for fair outcomes when delivery cannot be completed as described. Always contact support before opening a bank chargeback.
legal.refundSection1Body: You may request a refund if your order was not started within the stated delivery window, was not delivered at all, or was significantly incomplete due to a fault on our side.
legal.refundSection2Body: Refunds are not available for orders cancelled by the customer after delivery has started, for incorrect links or private accounts provided by the customer, or for platform actions outside our control.
legal.refundSection3Body: Contact support via WhatsApp, live chat, or email at support@myfreefollower.com with your order ID and account email. We review requests within 24–48 hours.
legal.refundSection4Body: Approved refunds are returned to your original payment method where possible. Crypto payments may be refunded in crypto or account credit by agreement. Card refunds typically appear within 5–10 business days depending on your bank.
legal.refundSection5Body: If only part of an order was delivered due to our error, we may offer a partial refund or completion of the remaining quantity. Partial refunds are calculated from the undelivered portion, not the full order total.
legal.refundSection6Body: Opening a chargeback with your bank before contacting support may delay resolution and lead to account suspension. Always email support@myfreefollower.com with your order ID first so we can investigate delivery logs.
legal.refundSection7Body: Approved refunds are initiated within 1–3 business days after approval. Crypto refunds depend on network confirmation times. You receive email confirmation when a refund is processed.
legal.refundSection8Body: Email support@myfreefollower.com, WhatsApp (+44 7544 368792), or Telegram (@buycheapfollowerr) with your order ID, account email, payment method, and a short description of the issue. Incomplete requests may take longer to review.
